zh.title: 阿提哈德航空推出Beyond Borders全新客艙體驗
zh.summary: 阿提哈德航空發布Beyond Borders；A330-900neo與A321LR換裝
body: 阿提哈德航空在杜拜舉行的阿拉伯旅遊市場上發布名為Beyond Borders的全新客艙體驗，涵蓋頭等艙、商務艙與經濟艙三個服務等級。
首批換裝的機型為空中巴士A330-900neo，預計2027年第四季投入服務，機上將設四間頭等艙套房、24座全平躺商務艙座椅、252座經濟艙座位，其中32座加大腿部空間。
接著將把Beyond Borders艙等延伸至A321LR，據ch-aviation數據，截至2026年9月阿提哈德已營運12架（共訂購30架）。航空公司已斥資10億美元進行客艙改裝，屬於200億美元投資計畫一部分。

en.title: Etihad Airways unveils Beyond Borders cabin experience for A330-900neo and A321LR
en.summary: Etihad launches Beyond Borders cabins; A330-900neo and A321LR to receive new interiors
body: Etihad Airways unveiled the Beyond Borders cabin concept at the Arabian Travel Market in Dubai on 14 September 2026. The programme covers first, business and economy classes and will be rolled out across the fleet.

The first aircraft to receive the new interiors are the Airbus A330-900neo, scheduled for entry into service in the fourth quarter of 2027. Each A330‑900neo will feature four first‑class suites with closing doors, 24 lie‑flat business seats with direct aisle access, and 252 economy seats, 32 of which offer an extra four inches of pitch.

Beyond Borders will next be installed on Etihad’s Airbus A321LR fleet; ch‑aviation data shows the airline operates 12 of the 30 ordered A321LRs as of September 2026. Etihad has earmarked US$1 billion for cabin retrofits within a broader US$20 billion investment plan.

sources.name: AeroTime — Etihad unveils Beyond Borders experience with new A330-900n…

facts.claim: Etihad Airways is introducing a revamped experience across first, business and economy classes.
facts.sourceQuote: Etihad Airways is introducing a revamped experience onboard its aircraft across three service classes (first, business and economy).

facts.claim: The Beyond Borders product was unveiled at the Arabian Travel Market in Dubai on 14 September 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: This new cabin product, named Beyond Borders, was unveiled during the Arabian Travel Market (ATM) trade show, which took place in Dubai on September 14, 2026.

facts.claim: The first aircraft to be line‑fitted with Beyond Borders cabins will be the Airbus A330-900neo, entering service in Q4 2027.
facts.sourceQuote: The first aircraft to be line-fitted with the new Beyond Borders cabins will be the airline’s Airbus A330-900neo aircraft, which are slated to enter service in the fourth quarter of 2027.

facts.claim: Etihad ordered 15 A330-900s in November 2025, six directly from Airbus and nine via Avolon.
facts.sourceQuote: Etihad placed an order for 15 A330-900s in November 2025 (six of these were ordered directly from Airbus and another nine through leasing company Avolon) as part of its growth strategy.

facts.claim: Beyond Borders cabins will next be fitted to Etihad’s A321LR fleet; the airline operates 12 of 30 ordered A321LRs as of September 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: Beyond Borders cabins will next be fitted into Etihad’s A321LR aircraft. According to ch-aviation data , as of September 2026, Etihad operates 12 of the 30 aircraft ordered from the European manufacturer.

facts.claim: The new A330-900neo Beyond Borders cabins will feature four first‑class suites, 24 lie‑flat business seats, 252 economy seats with 32 extra‑legroom seats.
facts.sourceQuote: The new A330-900 Beyond Borders cabins will each feature four first class suites with closed doors and enough space for two travel companions to dine or socialize together. In addition to first class, the A330-900 will also feature 24 full lie-flat business class seats with direct aisle access, as well as 252 economy class seats. 32 of the economy class seats will be extra legroom, offering four additional inches of pitch.
